title: shared.RegistrySpecification
description: RegistrySpecification contains information for connecting to local/remote registry

caCert.description: CACert is the Certificate Authority that signed the registry certificate.

cap.description: Specifies the maximum number of images from each repo to fetch and scan, sorted by most recently modified.

collections.description: Specifies the set of Defenders in-scope for working on a scan job.

credentialID.description: ID of the credentials in the credentials store to use for authenticating with the registry.

harborDeploymentSecurity.description: Indicates whether the Prisma Cloud plugin uses temporary tokens provided by Harbor to scan images in projects where Harbor's deployment security setting is enabled.

id.description: ID is a unique identifier of the registry spec.

jfrogRepoTypes.description: JFrog Artifactory repository types to scan.

lastScanStatus.description: LastScanStatus is the last scan status. we keep both LastScanStatus and ScanStatus in order to not lose the latest scan status when a scan starts.

lastScanTime.description: LastScanTime specifies the last time a scan was completed.

scanError.description: ScanError is the error received while scanning the specification.

scanStatus.description: ScanStatus is the scan status that's updated dynamically during the scan, when the scan finishes - its value is passed to the LastScanStatus field in the DB.

scanTime.description: ScanTime specifies the time a scan was started.

scannedImagesSuccessTotal.description: ScannedImagesSuccessTotal is the total number of registry images that were scanned successfully on the last registry specification scan.

scanners.description: Number of Defenders that can be utilized for each scan job.

version.description: Registry type. Determines the protocol Prisma Cloud uses to communicate with the registry.

versionPattern.description: Pattern heuristic for quickly filtering images by tags without having to query all images for modification dates.

common.CloudMetadata.description: CloudMetadata is the metadata for a cloud provider managed asset (e.g., as part of AWS/GCP/Azure/OCI)

image.description: The name of the image the cloud managed host or container is based on.

vmImageID.description: VMImageID holds the VM instance's image ID.

common.CloudProvider.description: CloudProvider specifies the cloud provider name

common.ExternalLabel.description: ExternalLabel holds an external label with a source and timestamp

sourceName.description: Source name (e.g., for a namespace, the source name can be 'twistlock').

timestamp.description: Time when the label was fetched.

common.ExternalLabelSourceType.description: ExternalLabelSourceType indicates the source of the labels

common.Secret.description: Secret Stores the plain and encrypted version of a value. The plain version is not stored in a database

encrypted.description: Specifies an encrypted value of the secret.

plain.description: Specifies the plain text value of the secret.

cred.AzureSPInfo.description: AzureSPInfo contains the Azure credentials needed for certificate based authentications

subscriptionId.description: SubscriptionID is a GUID that uniquely identifies the subscription to use Azure services.

tenantId.description: TenantID is the ID of the AAD directory in which the application was created.

cred.Credential.description: Credential specifies the authentication data of an external provider

_id.description: Specifies the unique ID for credential.

accountGUID.description: Specifies the unique ID for an IBM Cloud account.

accountID.description: Specifies the account identifier. Example: a username, access key, account GUID, and so on.

accountName.description: Specifies the name of the cloud account.

caCert.description: Specifies the CA certificate for a certificate-based authentication.

cloudProviderAccountID.description: Specifies the cloud provider account ID.

created.description: Specifies the time when the credential was created (or, when the account ID was changed for AWS).

description.description: Specifies the description for a credential.

external.description: Indicates whether the credential was onboarded from the Prisma platform.

global.description:
Indicates whether the credential scope is global.
Available values are:
true: Global
false: Not Global
Note: For GCP, the credential scope is the organization.

lastModified.description: Specifies the time when the credential was last modified.

owner.description: Specifies the user who created or modified the credential.

prismaLastModified.description: Specifies the time when the account was last modified by Prisma Cloud Compute.

roleArn.description: Specifies the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to be assumed.

skipVerify.description: Indicates whether to skip the certificate verification in TLS communication.

stsEndpoints.description: Specifies a list of specific endpoints for use in STS sessions in various regions.

useAWSRole.description:
Indicates whether to authenticate using the IAM Role attached to the instance.
Available values are:
true: Authenticate with the attached credentials
false: Don’t authenticate with the attached credentials.

useSTSRegionalEndpoint.description:
Indicates whether to use the regional STS endpoint for an STS session.
Available values are:
true: Use the regional STS
false: Don’t use the regional STS.

cred.OCICred.description: OCICred are additional parameters required for OCI credentials

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint is the public key signature.

tenancyId.description: TenancyID is the OCID of the tenancy.

cred.TemporaryToken.description:
TemporaryToken is a temporary session token for cloud provider APIs
AWS - https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/id_credentials_temp.html
GCP - https://cloud.google.com/iam/docs/creating-short-lived-service-account-credentials
Azure - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/manage-apps/what-is-single-sign-on

duration.description: Specifies a duration for the token.

expirationTime.description: Specifies an expiration time for the token.

shared.GitlabRegistrySpec.description: GitlabRegistrySpec represents a specification for registry scanning in GitLab

shared.JFrogRepoType.description: JFrogRepoType represents the type of JFrog Artifactory repository

shared.RegistryOSType.description: RegistryOSType specifies the registry images base OS type
